chronology.market_state_information_cutoff: the completed signal-date close; latest_source_timestamp must be no later than decision_at
chronology.rule_origin: manual one-by-one review of all 1047 V3 twelve-month charts in consumed 2014-2020 development history

evaluation.baseline: +20 percent target or H60, no structural failure exit, 40 bp round trip
diagnostics: annual completed count and mean/median net return

frozen_rules.rule: The resistance coordinate is the prior 250-session high already known at the signal; it must have remained unbroken for at least 60 completed market sessions. The coordinate is frozen for the trade and may never be redefined from future extrema.

Keep the exact mother signal: first non-limit completed close through the stale high, no more than 5 percent above it, 2-9.5 percent completed step return, turnover at least 1.5 times its prior-20 completed-session mean, and close location at least 0.75. Enter the first legal executable open strictly later, within three market sessions.

Freeze the registered causal market state observed at the signal. In BEAR or TRANSITION, two consecutive legal completed daily closes below the frozen stale-high coordinate confirm failed acceptance. In BULL, three consecutive legal completed daily closes below the coordinate confirm failed acceptance. Sell at the first later legal sellable open. Missing, late, or unknown market state fails closed.

If no earlier structural-failure exit occurs, retain the exact +20 percent target and H60 lifecycle. Target observation requires a legal completed/sellable session after T+1; H60 information is acted on only at the next legal sellable open. Entry and exit costs remain 20 bp per side.

market_state_semantics.definition: existing registered causal BULL/BEAR/TRANSITION state joined on signal_date
forbidden: state changes selected after seeing trade outcome

discarded_visual_ideas: require an immediate post-entry surge: rejected because many eventual winners advanced slowly
exit on the first close below stale high: rejected because profitable charts often made one ordinary retest
blanket bear-market exclusion: rejected because profitable charts existed in every causal state
pre-breakout return cap: rejected because fast prior rises appeared in both winners and failures
same-date crowding veto: rejected because clustered dates appeared in both winners and failures
rule_compression_rationale.retained_mechanism: A successful absorption breakout converts the old supply ceiling into a durable price floor. Persistent acceptance back below that pre-existing coordinate falsifies the trade. Weak/transition markets require faster confirmation because broad demand is weaker; bull markets allow one additional retest session.
